Shitlord/lady(s)

An old friend of mine used to always make fun of larger people simply because he was disgusted by them. He felt that they should be ashamed for letting themselves get to that size. Now for the ones subjected to the hate.

The 'Fatties'

I don't really expect to receive a response from them, nor do I expect them to actually be browsing here at all. So I'll guess I'll refrain from asking a question and instead try to get to the bottom of their behaviour.

From my understanding one becomes overweight from a number of issues. I don't believe that genetics plays a role however and I think when people try to use that as an excuse they are perhaps referring to the cultural/social inheritance of unhealthy eating. I don't think we can be genetically fat, we can be built bigger with broader frames and smaller with slender frames but not overweight. That is just my educated guess. In that instance it is the fault of the parents for not introducing more healthy eating habits and for not leading by example.

I think it is safe to say that depression is probably the leading cause of overeating which can be caused by a variety of things such as physical/mental trauma, lack of confidence/self-esteem etc. Another reason to a lesser extent would be what I mentioned before, they simply learn unhealthy eating habits from their parents and it continues on with them to adulthood (probably the same reason why their parents were overweight).

Anyway this depression forces them to eat because of the momentary satisfaction and pleasure they receive and depending on what they consume, the response they receive from consuming aphrodisiac foods.

It is an addiction, like any other.

The only thing is that afterwards they immediately feel regret and ashamed for consuming so much and what do they do to eliminate that feeling?

You guessed it! (I hope)

They eat more.

Thus the destructive feedback loop is born. Input is food, output is guilt and so on.

I'm concerned however that they have now fallen victim to what is known as confirmatory bias. They are seeking out posts and others who only serve to confirm their acceptance of such destructive behaviour(s). I'm all for body acceptance but not for it when it serves in furthering destructive habits that will eventually lead to demise. You will be transformed if you are committed and you will experience your own life like you never have before, one that is unimaginably better to what you may be currently experiencing.
